mutants.description: The foreign multi-instance path must split the two source instances; bypassing its production gate leaves one object with two instances.

The clone volume build must run for each split object; retaining the call syntactically while forcing the condition false leaves the clone empty, and the public nonempty/raw-volume witness catches the omission.
Each clone must receive the trailing source instance being split off; copying the front instance repeatedly loses the second world offset while the original delete still terminates the loop.
